snippet.title: The Driver Syndicate Trailer (Driver 20th Anniversary)
snippet.description:
Fanmade trailer to not only celebrate Driver's 20th anniversary (June 25 in EU and June 30 in NA) but also Driver Syndicate, a spiritual successor to Driver that at it's essence, is a love letter to the entire series.

Driver Syndicate is created by InspirationByte, also known as SOAP and it runs on his very own Equilibrium engine. Mainly pulling inspiration from Driver 1 & 2, it's a short but sweet dive back into an experience like that of early Driver games, with some basic driving games and freeroam to play with, backed up by fully functional traffic and cop AI to make things lively. 

Song used - Driver San Francisco Main Theme.

Download The Driver Syndicate: 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1KOig9sXaLo9QwhL6tYSVsaqY4n_tqbeI/view?usp=sharing
